name: Vi
notes: Blast Shield (P) is a pure self-shield with no damage component, so it is left out of the kit entirely.

The opening cast is Cease and Desist (R); it lands castTimeS + grabDelayS after the cast (the dummy is assumed close enough that the dash itself takes no extra time), and blocks attacks for that whole window.

Relentless Force (E) is armed right after an attack lands (as in Jax's Empower) so its attack-reset only costs one windup instead of a full attack period; its bonus damage is modeled with crit_mod=true since the ability itself can critically strike against the primary target.

Relentless Force's per-rank recharge time is read from the wiki-quoted values (which match Vault Breaker's array, [12, 10.5, 9, 7.5, 6]) rather than the bin's flat cooldown=1 field: that field is read here as ViE.StaticCooldown, the minimum gap between two casts made from stocked charges, not the recharge time. Vi starts the fight with both charges stocked.

Vault Breaker (Q) is always charged to the full 1.25 s that caps its damage/range/speed scaling (charging to the 4-6 s auto-cancel point is never worth it): the charge blocks attacks, the recast's damage lands automatically at 1.25 s (min damage x2.5 max-charge multiplier), and its cooldown starts there (post-effect), not at the initial cast.

Denting Blows (W): basic attacks (including the Relentless Force-empowered one) and Vault Breaker's dash each apply one stack; the 3rd stack-applying hit consumes all three for bonus physical damage (percent of the dummy's maximum health, uncapped since the dummy counts as an enemy champion) plus a 20% armor shred and a self attack-speed buff, both 4 s.
Mana costs are not tracked: Q/E/R cooldowns and E's charge system already gate casting well inside a 15 s fight.

assumed.why: assume Vi begins the fight with both Relentless Force charges stocked, as normal at the start of a fight.
